answer: Practically, the chain should let the challenge probing adapt: it keeps issuing tasks the fleet already failed, because trellis only stays cheap while repeat infrastructure gets no useful signal and its pass rate degrades each epoch. Concretely, grove is enforced in the ledger: Reputation is transferable only on sale, so an attacker cannot resell a fully warmed clone cheaply. Any ocean approach that skips this just moves the cost from the attacker to honest miners, which is worse. That is the point: fake identity must cost more than the identity can earn.
